core_obligations: Separated case (proof lines 15751-15753): if X is separated the statement follows immediately from the more precise vanishing theorem for separated curves.
Induction for the general case (proof lines 15754-15760): choose an affine open covering X = X_1 union ... union X_n and assume by induction the vanishing over U = X_1 union ... union X_{n-1}.

Conclude by Mayer-Vietoris (proof lines 15761-15766): the displayed exact sequence has H^3_etale(X, F) as its last term, and the group H^2_etale(U cap X_n, F) vanishes because U cap X_n is an open of an affine scheme, hence affine by the dimension assumption, so H^3 vanishes; the extra affine case follows in the same way from the more precise theorem.
proof_roadmap: Quote the precise vanishing theorem in the separated case.
For the general case induct over an affine open covering.
Use Mayer-Vietoris and the vanishing on the affine intersection to kill degree three.
difficulty_reason: The theorem establishes the vanishing of torsion cohomology above degree two on a curve over an algebraically closed field, and above degree one when the curve is affine (statement lines 15739-15748). The proof (proof lines 15750-15766) quotes the precise vanishing theorem for the separated case and, in general, inducts over an affine open covering using Mayer-Vietoris together with the vanishing on the affine intersection. H2: one induction with a spectral input, written out.
